summary: Frontend-only test of the Jam Session 'Save to Album' popup at 844x390 and 390x844. Real recording worked headless: Record -> keys pressed -> Stop -> capture-save-album-btn appeared in a few seconds. All 6 requested items pass. Step 1: jam-name-input is 58px tall (528px wide in landscape, 310px in portrait), gets focus automatically, and it and jam-name-save fit fully on screen. Step 2: jam-saved-title shows '“Test Jam” is saved!'. All four choices fit on screen: a 2x2 grid in landscape (y 143-319 of 390) and one column in portrait. jam-next-keep closes the popup, you stay on #/free-play, and the jam-go-to-album pill shows. jam-next-cover goes to #/academy?panel=album&cover=<id> with academy-album and cover-designer open, titled 'Test Jam'. jam-next-stage goes to #/rank-hall?jam=<id> and Main Stage loads showing 'NOW PLAYING: Test Jam' in both orientations. jam-next-album opens the album panel without the designer. No page errors. Two React dev-mode console errors remain (details below).
action_items: Minor: FreePlayPage <audio data-testid='jam-along-audio' src={jamTrackId ? ... : ''}> passes an empty src, which logs a React console error. Pass undefined/null instead of ''.

Minor: on first load a React 'Encountered two children with the same key' console error appears. Its source wasn't found from the dev bundle; check list keys on the free-play page and in the tour/name-prompt modals.
critical_code_review_comments: JamSavedPopup step 1 has no cancel or close button and no backdrop dismiss. The jam is already saved before naming (saveJam runs in handleSaveJam), so the kid has to press Save. That is acceptable, but a 'Skip' option could help.
handleSaveJam swallows all errors silently. If saveJam fails, the kid gets no feedback.
seed_data_creation: About 6 'Test Jam' jams were saved, only in the headless browser's own local storage. No server data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Headless recording works: click capture-jam-btn, press keyboard keys, click capture-stop-btn, then wait for capture-save-album-btn (up to 20s). Dismiss modals with the text "I'll add my name later" and tour-start-modal-close. The cover designer testid is cover-designer.
